purpose: Blind cross-material test of the B01 hydraulic-penetration scaling hypothesis for the location of standard-LARE interface-gradient aliasing.

blind_material.prior_role: existing ROM1X1 material-transfer material; no B14 trajectory under the DYN0A 1024-step fixed-flux forcing family has been inspected in MECH2B

forcing_transfer.top_flux_definition: same DYN0A multipliers 1.0, 1.5 and 0.5 times material-specific K0

spatial_transfer.representation: one upper layer 0-L cm followed by 10-cm layers to 160 cm

frozen_scaling.diffusivity: D0=K(h0)/C(h0) from the initial B14 Mualem-van Genuchten state

blind_predictions.rule: Use only WET and DRY first-pulse RMS interface-flux error, exactly as MECH2A.

Se0_0.65.rationale: All available lambda values are above the B01 peak band; if the scaling transfers, the maximum over the frozen ladder occurs at the smallest available L.

same_as_MECH2A: pulse RMS standard-LARE interface flux error for every frozen L
pulse maximum absolute interface flux error
L and lambda of maximum pulse RMS error
transfer_tests: exact predicted peak L agreement for each WET/DRY case
for direct-band cases: observed peak lambda inside frozen B01 band
for left-censored Se0=0.65: observed maximum at L=10
observed B14 peak-lambda band and deviation from B01 band

adjudication.SCALING_TRANSFER_SUPPORTED: All qualified WET/DRY cases satisfy their frozen peak-location prediction; direct-band cases peak inside the frozen B01 lambda band and left-censored cases peak at L=10.
adjudication.SCALING_TRANSFER_PARTIAL: At least one but not all saturation anchors satisfy the frozen transfer rule.
adjudication.SCALING_TRANSFER_NOT_SUPPORTED: No consistent transfer of the frozen peak-location rule is observed.
adjudication.reference_blocker: If the new B14 fine Reference trajectories cannot be qualified under the unchanged DYN0A numerical authority, close as B14_REFERENCE_BLOCKED rather than retuning.
